metadata.title: SPGD-TME V2 reproducibility release: locked reportability and donor-split operators
metadata.description: Reproducibility materials for the revised Methods manuscript Two locked operators report mixed-spot TME composition on CosMx carcinomas. The release contains the review-build manuscript, native point-to-point reviewer responses, LaTeX source, locked plot data, frozen constants, rendering scripts, and table generators. It contains no patient-level raw sequencing files. Source libraries and reference-building inputs remain subject to the terms of their original providers; this record makes no blanket redistribution claim for provider-specific agreements.
metadata.notes: The package supports render-level and locked-result-level reproduction. Any raw-to-fit reconstruction requiring source-library or reference-building inputs must follow the original data-provider access conditions.
